about.title: Alhambra Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When someone dies because of another person's carelessness, the paperwork tends to arrive before the grief has any room to settle. In 2025, Alhambra recorded 301 injury collisions with 418 people hurt, and two of those crashes ended in a death. Collision reports in the city cluster along the I-10 San Bernardino Freeway, Main Street, Valley Boulevard and Mission Road, most often on Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. A wrongful death claim in California is a civil action, entirely separate from any criminal case the Los Angeles County District Attorney may bring. It allows a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, and in some cases dependent heirs, to seek compensation for funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. The deadline is generally two years from the date of death, and shorter when a government entity is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects you with an independent attorney who works on contingency, so nothing is owed unless there is a recovery.

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can confirm where your family fits before any deadline becomes a problem.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, but the window shrinks considerably when a city, county or state agency is involved. Getting connected quickly protects that timeline.

items.title: No fee unless there is a recovery
items.desc: Every attorney in our network takes wrongful death cases on contingency, and our connection service costs nothing. Your family can pursue funeral costs, lost support and the loss of companionship without paying anything up front.

items.question: My relative was killed in a crash on the I-10 through Alhambra. Does it matter who maintains the road?
items.answer: It can. When a claim involves a public entity, such as a state or county agency responsible for a roadway, California requires a formal government claim on a much shorter timeline than the usual two years. An attorney can determine early whether any public entity is part of the picture and file accordingly, while still pursuing the driver or other private parties.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges in Los Angeles County. Do we have to wait for that case to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a separate civil action with its own deadline, and it proceeds whether or not there is a conviction. The criminal case can sometimes provide useful evidence, but your family's right to seek compensation does not depend on its outcome.

items.question: What can our family actually recover in a California wrongful death case?
items.answer: Recoverable losses generally include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would have contributed over their lifetime, and the loss of their love, companionship, care and guidance. Every family's situation is different, so an attorney will look at your specific circumstances rather than offering a number in advance.
